segments.actionDescription: From the braced greatsword anticipation pose, perform the fast first half of a committed waist-to-chest descending greatsword cut and land exactly in the supplied contact pose. Keep both hands locked to the same sword, preserve the dark red cloak, iron plate, split helm crest, low top-down camera, planted feet, body identity, pixel clusters and north-left key light. No detached weapon, duplicate body, extra limb, magic trail or camera motion.

Continue from the exact greatsword contact pose through the follow-through and settle exactly into the supplied recover pose. Keep both hands locked to the same sword, preserve the dark red cloak, iron plate, split helm crest, low top-down camera, planted feet, body identity, pixel clusters and north-left key light. No detached weapon, duplicate body, extra limb, magic trail or camera motion.
